sources.finding: Attend cooking, turn off burner on leaving or if oil smokes; heat itself is required for cooking.
Hot-water storage temperatures balance legionella risk; mixing valves reduce outlet scalding. Do not generically lower storage temperature.
Unplug except appliances designed to remain on, e.g. refrigerator/freezer; keep working alarms.
UK sockets already have safety shutters; no universal requirement to fit inserts. Avoid decorative covers attractive to children.
